captured_from: SYNTHETIC (not a container capture): a minimal, well-formed HTTP/1.0 status line with no `Server:` header at all, per RFC 9112 SS4 ("status-line = HTTP-version SP status-code SP [ reason-phrase ]"). Built by hand to pin the weak-evidence path (http.protocol.bare.v1) -- a real server that omits or suppresses its `Server` header, which several hardened deployments deliberately do.
